meta.face: A man of about sixty with short thick white hair receding from a high forehead, a full rounded white beard of medium length, strong dark eyebrows, deep-set dark eyes and a warm, faintly amused half-smile, eyes slightly lowered.
meta.basis: The official portrait photograph of about 1947; the fingerless mittens over the stigmata from contemporary accounts. The excerpt is his best-known counsel.
